description: In lowering, a constant is its value, so one whose value is the empty set is an empty set: the guarded term `matches($x, loop) ⟹ $E` is dropped, and the nested parse that would fail with an error of the grammar never runs (engine §3.6, §10).
grammar:
%const $E B ∖ B
%rule text $x(X) <Y ∪ (matches($x, loop) ⟹ $E)>
%rule loop $l(X)
%conditions matches($l, loop)
